scope: Official PIT filing metadata/timestamp recovery for the exact upstream 186-company research universe

pit_policy.availability_rule: Use the latest official timestamp present on the filing row among publication/broadcast/revised/creation timestamps.
pit_policy.revisions: Preserve revisions as separate immutable events; order versions by effective availability, never by label alone.
pit_policy.timestamp_disagreements: Preserve and audit as warnings unless effective availability creates an actual chronological impossibility.
